rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone loses a chance, right, or benefit because of wrongdoing or non-compliance.

example.english: If you break the contract terms, you will forfeit the deposit.
example.traditional: 你違反合約條款，就會失去筆按金。
example.jyutping: nei5 wai4 faan2 hap6 joek3 tiu4 fun2 zau6 wui6 sat1 heoi3 bat1 on3 gam1

rows.note: Use this when a person or team voluntarily withdraws from, or fails to take part in, a competition.

example.english: I’m ill today, so I have to forfeit and not take part in the match.
example.traditional: 我今日病咗，唯有棄權，唔參加場比賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 beng6 zo2 wai4 jau5 hei3 kyun4 m4 caam1 gaa1 coeng4 bei2 coi3

rows.note: Use this when an authority or referee declares someone the loser because of a rule violation or failure to show up.

example.english: The referee made them forfeit because they failed to show up on time.
example.traditional: 裁判判輸佢哋，因為佢哋冇按時出場。
example.jyutping: coi4 pun3 pun3 syu1 keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 mou5 on3 si4 ceot1 coeng4
